dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric narrowing from the cranial-midsection transitioning to a rapid, pronounced thinning toward a long, slender peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Margins are predominantly smooth and symmetrical with no significant bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the majority of the dorsal surface with a subtle blue-grey cast.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, elongated dorsal ridge casting a linear shadow along the posterior midline; distinct dark blowhole at the anterior end.
